rounds.plain: The pipeline estimate says the service requires site assessment, quoting, crew coordination, and physical work, making it a poor fit for a 5-hour weekly limit. The recorded kill reasons also include local-business selling and UK legal risk from unsolicited marketing texts to homeowners; K1 means it breaks a hard rule, while C9 means there is no plausible handover to ≤5 h/week.

risks: Physical, local work requires more than 5 hours per week according to the pipeline estimate.
The acquisition method described includes unsolicited marketing texts to homeowners; the source says UK PECR bans those texts to individuals and sole traders.
The validation says the UK market is saturated, citing ~6,975 arborist firms from commercial directory data.
Some revenue and job figures are estimates or ambiguous.

hours.note: Pipeline estimate; site assessment, quoting, crew coordination, and service issues need human oversight.

records.next_steps: Recheck UK crew costs, insurance and equipment prices, plus Facebook Marketplace rules and the cited job economics.
